title: LinkedIn lead generation agency source review
methodology: Manual Browserbase review of provider-controlled pages. Summaries describe advertised scope, not independently verified performance. Unpaid, unranked inclusion; publisher sells a competing service. Displayed dollar prices without a confirmed currency code are not treated as USD or used for a price ranking.

providers.scope: Founder-led managed LinkedIn campaign: targeting, research, messaging, replies and meeting booking.
providers.price: 1,500 USD/month; no per-meeting fee; tools and third-party data extra.

providers.scope: LinkedIn, cold-email and cold-calling services; confirm the selected package and delivery team.
providers.price: LinkedIn starting price $397/month confirmed in same-day pricing review; exact currency code and old tier matrix not confirmed.

providers.scope: Managed B2B outbound with LinkedIn as the flagship channel and cold email in support, including reply follow-up and booking.
providers.price: Page displays Launch from $1,500, Growth from $3,000 and Scale from $6,000 monthly, but says final tier pricing is being confirmed. Obtain written pricing; currency code not confirmed.

providers.scope: Manual LinkedIn and email outreach, with Core and Boutique campaign models.
providers.price: Core from $1,500/month; Boutique from $3,700/month. Currency code not confirmed.

providers.scope: Context-based LinkedIn outreach, executive communication and GTM systems that can be handed to the client team; email where it adds context.
providers.price: A numeric quote was not reviewed in this comparison; request current written terms.

providers.scope: Managed LinkedIn-account outreach and appointment setting with client message approval; a WhatsApp number uses one account slot.
providers.price: Page displays $499/month for up to ten accounts plus $49 per held meeting; other periods have different upfront terms. Currency code not confirmed. Inspect held-event acceptance, automatic acceptance and dispute rules.

providers.scope: Personalized LinkedIn and email outreach positioned around qualified leads and appointments.
providers.price: Numeric service pricing was not reviewed in this comparison; request current written terms. Published lead-volume and money-back claims are provider claims, not validated results.
